why: Web unit tests written for the Stockholm site: they assert the Swedish/English pair, SWEREF 99 coordinates, the
arg/blatimme/kalk/foto looks and the poster's paper sizes. The Zagreb port has Croatian, its own looks and its own
poster, so these fail for a reason that says nothing about this fork. scripts/web-tests.mjs skips them and prints
the count, so CI still gates on everything this fork does run. Porting a test means deleting its name here.
